sharedRules.title: Multiple effects setting the LIMITED Support allowance do not add together
sharedRules.expectedBehavior: hBP06-008 SP Oshi Skill and hBP09-087 Collab Effect each set the total turn allowance for LIMITED Support cards to two. Activating both effects does not grant four total uses; after two LIMITED Supports have been played, another is illegal. The separate prohibition on the first player's first-turn LIMITED Support remains in force. Comprehensive Rules 8.4.2 allows any active Back Holomem, including a 2nd, to Collab.

sharedRules.title: A Collab Effect requires an actual Collab action; moving a Holomem into Collab by effect does not trigger it
sharedRules.expectedBehavior: A Collab Effect is a triggered ability whose condition is that its Holomem Collabs. When hBP09-050 moves an opposing Holomem into the Collab position by its effect, that movement is not treated as a Collab action and does not trigger the moved Holomem's Collab Effect (official Q725). The movement also does not record a Collab action for that opponent; this counter behavior is verified in the reducers and follows from the movement not being a Collab action.

sharedRules.title: Previous-turn Down conditions are keyed by the Down Holomem owner and turn, not the effect source
sharedRules.expectedBehavior: For an effect that asks whether one of your Holomen was Down during the preceding opponent turn, count Down records whose owner is the acting player and whose turn is the immediately preceding turn. The sourcePlayerIndex is not a printed condition and must not be required to equal the opponent. Do not count opponent-owned Downs or older-turn events.

sharedRules.title: A hidden-zone search may fail to find a matching card even when one is present
officialRulingSources: https://hololive-official-cardgame.com/cardlist/?id=2808 (hBP09-091/Q734 for direct staging; hidden-zone choice governed by the Comprehensive Rules)
sharedRules.expectedBehavior: When a player must choose a card from a hidden zone and obtaining card information is necessary, the player may fail to find even if a matching card is present. Do not turn such a search into a mandatory exact-count choice. This does not mean the effect is optional when a match is visible in a public zone or when the rule/effect specifically requires a public selection.
applicationScope: Website deck-search effects and pending cardSelection validation
Production Android offline NativeRules bundle
Production Android Firebase PvP NativeRules reducer
testIds: website/tests/effect-audit-hbp09-091-q734.test.mjs: cardIds:[] accepted with a matching AZKi in deck and subsequent Iroha search still resolves
android-current/tests/hbp09-091-q734-release.test.mjs: packaged offline/PvP fail-to-find-then-continue path
evidence: Comprehensive Rules 1.9.0 clause 10.7.2.3.5 expressly permits failing to find a card in a hidden zone even if a matching card is there.
The former test requiring min=1 when matching cards were present asserted the opposite, so it was withdrawn as an invalid test expectation. No runtime change to search minimum is retained.
runtimeEvidence: Website source test and browser harness directly execute empty selection and next search; packaged Android offline/PvP tests do the same under Node VM. Physical Android runtime unavailable.
outstanding: Review other hidden-zone search abilities and their target construction independently; one hBP09-091 case does not prove all search effects conform.

rows.officialJapaneseText: [ホロパワー：-X]女幹部の采配[ターンに1回]自分の赤ホロメンの能力で手札をアーカイブする時に使える：アーカイブする手札1枚につき自分のホロパワー1枚を、かわりにアーカイブできる。
rows.expectedBehavior: While a red Holomem ability is resolving and would archive N cards from the hand, the owner may replace some or all of those hand cards one-for-one with up to N available Holo Power cards, choosing no more than the available power count. Mixed payment is legal, Holo Power may exceed the hand size, and the Oshi skill is limited to once per turn.

sourceSpec.name: 女幹部的指揮
sourceSpec.effect: [每回合1次]當自己的紅色Holomem能力要將手牌存檔時可以使用：每要存檔1張手牌，就可以改為將自己的1張Holo Power存檔。

officialRulingEvidence: Official Q34 (2024-09-21): the owner may choose a mixture of hand cards and Holo Power for the replacement.
Official Q35 (2024-09-21): the chosen Holo Power amount may exceed the number of cards in hand, up to available Holo Power.
Official hBP01 product card list: https://hololive-official-cardgame.com/cardlist/cardsearch/?expansion=hBP01&view=text
regressionEvidence: website/tests/simulator-lui-payment-audit.test.mjs: Q34 and Q35 rule-grounded scenarios already pass through the website action/choice pipeline.
android-current/tests/lui-payment-release.test.mjs: Q34 and Q35 prepared/committed actions pass through the currently packaged NativeRules asset.
runtimeEvidence: Website engine applyAction path and packaged Android engine.js in Node VM: Q34/Q35 pass.
Browser interaction and Android QuickJS/JNI/device runtime are not yet exercised.
outstanding: Complete mixed payment boundary cases, stale choice and cancellation/save-load/replay, verify non-red and wrong-timing rejection, and run browser plus Android QuickJS/JNI/device tests.

officialRulingEvidence: Official Q53 (2024-09-21): after an odd result, damage resolves and the same Art must be used again before another Holomem can use Arts.
Official Q226 (2024-10-23): each use deals damage separately; odd results do not multiply one damage event.
Official Q712 (2026-09-11): nine repeated uses plus the initial use count as ten Arts uses for Towa's draw skill.
Official card text says to repeat against the same Holomem until that Holomem is down; https://hololive-official-cardgame.com/cardlist/?id=56
regressionEvidence: website/tests/effect-audit-hbp09-005-q709-q713.test.mjs: Q53 command and candidate ordering plus target identity lock; pass.
website/tests/effect-audit-repeat-arts-rulings.test.mjs: Q712 ten separately counted Arts uses and target-down repeat cleanup; pass.
runtimeEvidence: Current website production engine applyAction and candidate API: PASS for these rule branches.
Browser UI and a matching current Android game-app bundle are unavailable in this checkout; runtime parity is unverified.

rows.officialJapaneseText:
■このファンが付いているホロメンのアーツ+10。
■このファンが付いているホロメンがダメージを受ける時、このファンをアーカイブする。
このファンは、自分の〈紫咲シオン〉だけに付けられ、1人につき何枚でも付けられる。
rows.expectedBehavior: After all damage modifiers determine a positive incoming Arts or special-damage amount, archive each attached hBP02-102 before applying that amount to the Holomem's damage total. If the final amount is zero, the Holomem does not receive damage and the Fan stays attached. The independent Arts +10 and own-Shion attachment restriction remain unverified in this batch.

officialRulingEvidence: Official Japanese card text: hBP02-102 grants attached Shion Holomen Arts +10 and archives this Fan when the attached Holomen is about to receive damage.
Official Q227 (2024-10-23): 'damage received' is after HP decreases; 'about to receive damage' is after damage is confirmed and before it is dealt.
Official card/Q&A: https://hololive-official-cardgame.com/cardlist/?id=369 and https://hololive-official-cardgame.com/rules/question/faq/
regressionEvidence: website/tests/simulator-shion-fan-zero-audit.test.mjs: actual Arts action with two legal Shion Fans archives both, deals exactly 30, and preserves a Fan when the final Arts amount is reduced to zero; 12/12 focused assertions pass.
android-current/tests/shion-fan-q227-release.test.mjs: same state outcomes through the packaged 1.2.5 NativeRules dispatcher; 2/2 pass.
runtimeEvidence: Website production engine applyAction state settlement: PASS for cited branches; browser UI not exercised.
Packaged Android engine.js production bundle in Node VM: PASS; QuickJS/JNI and device runtime not exercised.
outstanding: Verify the +10 Arts bonus, legal attachment and stale/removed-target cases; cover special damage using a normal production action; test save/load/replay and each damage-prevention interaction; run website browser and Android QuickJS/JNI/device tests.

rows.officialJapaneseText:
このツールが付いているホロメンのアーツ+10。

◆1st以上の#ID3期生を持つホロメンに付いているなら、追加でこのツールが付いているホロメンのアーツ+10。

ツールは、1人のホロメンに1枚しか付けられない。
rows.expectedBehavior: Every equipped Holomem gets +10 Arts damage from the Tool. A wearer with 1st-or-higher stage and #ID3期生 gets an additional +10. The one-Tool-per-Holomem rule still applies.

officialRulingEvidence: The official Japanese hBP04-098 entry states the general +10, the separate additional +10 condition for an eligible #ID3期生 wearer, and the one-Tool-per-Holomem restriction.
regressionEvidence: Before repair, both Android packaged modes calculated only the generic +10 and dealt 40 where the conditional additional +10 made the legal total 50. A parser boundary omitted the word 再 immediately before +10 in the additional clause. Website and Android-source parser now include 再/額外 in that boundary; both Android NativeRules bundles were regenerated and pass the 50-damage action regression.
runtimeEvidence: Focused website action test and exact packaged Android Offline/PvP tests: PASS. Website evidence uses current-source applyAction and manually-operated Chromium harnesses, not complete SimulatorClient production gameplay. Android host tests run the exact rebuilt APK-owned Offline and Firebase PvP JavaScript bundles through Node VM adapters, not Android QuickJS/JNI/WebView or an installed device.
outstanding: Actual Android app runtime and complete production browser interaction remain to be verified; full card, printing and shared-rule audit gates remain open.

rows.expectedBehavior: (1) An attached Makeup tool grants +20 Arts to the attached Kirara Vivi. (2) While attached to a Center-position 1st-or-higher Kirara Vivi, its mandatory Performance-end trigger offers an optional choice to Bloom one own FLOW GLOW Holomem that Bloomed this turn, using a matching Holomem card from hand. The repeat-Bloom rule bypasses only the already-Bloomed-this-turn restriction, once per target for that turn; ordinary same-name, level progression, entry-turn, HP, and other Bloom restrictions remain. Bloom preserves damage and stage identity. (3) The shared Tool limit permits at most one Tool per Holomem.

officialRulingEvidence: Official Japanese hBP09-109 card-list text (card id 2963) defines the +20 attached Vivi Arts modifier, the Center-only Performance-end added ability, the one selected FLOW GLOW Holomem that Bloomed this turn, and the one-Tool-per-Holomem cap; no card-specific Q&A/erratum was found in the inspected official entry.

Comprehensive rules 1.9.0 section 5.28.1 says the already-Bloomed-this-turn condition alone may be ignored once for a qualifying repeat Bloom. Sections 8.3.2-8.3.4 retain entry-turn, matching name, allowed Bloom progression and HP conditions; section 5.14.2 preserves damage across Bloom.
Comprehensive rules 1.9.0 sections 10.8.1-10.8.3 define trigger timing and processing; the card text makes the target action an optional Bloom. Section 5.17.3.1 imposes the shared Tool cap.
regressionEvidence: Before-fix website applyAction reproduction: normal Bloom, then hBP06-090 Bloom Stage extra Bloom on the same FLOW GLOW Holomem, then hBP09-109 at Performance end incorrectly offered a third Bloom. The assertion failed because pendingChoice.type was stageTarget instead of null.
Before-fix packaged Android 1.2.5 engine.js NativeRules reproduction failed on the same semantic condition through prepare/commit.

After-fix, the unit records extraBloomUsedTurn. Same target is no longer offered; a different target remains eligible, proving rule 5.28 is tracked per Holomem rather than incorrectly per player. Optional target/card decline, name/level eligibility, damage/rest preservation and Arts +20 pass on website and packaged Android host route.

A legacy midturn save with global prior generic bonus-Bloom usage but missing per-unit markers cannot offer the same stage unit for a second extra Bloom; migration fails closed to preserve the 5.28.1 once-per-target restriction.

clauses.catalogText: [每場遊戲1次]直到下個對手的回合結束前，對手的中衛Holomem與合作Holomem不能進行接力、移動或替換。

clauses.catalogText: [每場遊戲1次]在對手的回合中，當自己的紅色Holomen被擊倒時可使用：自己受到的生命值減少-1。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後，選擇被擊倒的1人，將該Holomen及其重疊的所有Holomen返回手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [每回合1次]當這位推しHolomen或自己的藍屬Holomen對對手的後排Holomen造成傷害時可使用：對該對手的其中1位後排Holomen造成50點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [每場遊戲1次]當自己的藍屬Holomen對對手的前排Holomen或合作Holomen造成傷害時可使用：對對手的其中1位後排Holomen造成等同該數值的特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [每回合1次] 當你因自己的藍色Holomen的能力將應援送進檔案區時可以使用：對對手的一位Holomen造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [每場遊戲1次] 將自己檔案區中的1～5張應援，分配並送給自己擁有#ID的Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 此技能只能以對手的中央成員為對象。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 此成員卡在牌組中可放入任意張數
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這個回合內，我方中央的Holomen藝術值+10。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若我方中央的Holomen擁有#４期生，則我方中央的Holomen藝術值再+20。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以擲一次骰子：若為3或以下，從自己的牌庫公開1張吉祥物，並附加到自己的Holomen上。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的中央Holomem造成30點特殊傷害（即使被擊倒也不會讓對手的生命減少）。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的中央Holomen造成50點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 使用此技能使對手的Holomen倒下時，若造成的傷害比剩餘HP多出50以上，對手生命-1。

clauses.catalogText: 這回合中如果你曾使用過支援卡，這個Arts+20。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這張Holomen可以在牌組中放入任意張數
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當自己的中央Holomem擁有#Promise時，抽1張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 你可以公開自己牌庫頂的1張牌：如果公開的卡牌具有#Promise，這個Arts+20。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將公開的卡牌加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從Debut Bloom時，從自己的牌庫中公開1張具有#Promise且不是Buzz的[Debut Holo成員或1st Holo成員]，將該卡加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從自己的牌庫中公開1張持有#Promise的Holomen，加入手牌。

clauses.catalogText: 然後洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這回合中，每有1位在自己後排的Holomen，自己的前排Holomen與合作Holomen的Arts+10。

clauses.catalogText: 這張Holomen可以在牌組中放入任意張數
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 抽一張自己的牌庫卡。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 抽取自己牌庫上方的2張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以擲一次骰子：若為奇數，對同一位Holomen再使用一次此技能（此技能可重複使用，直到該Holomen倒下為止）。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這位holo成員可以在牌組中放入任意張數
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 在我方的重置步驟中，若我方中央Holomen為〈フワワ・アビスガード〉，此Holomen移動到後方位置時不會進入休息狀態。

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的中央Holomen造成10點特殊傷害。

clauses.catalogText: [每回合1次]直到回合結束為止，讓1位裝備有自己的#こよラボ支援卡的〈博衣こより〉，其Arts+30。

clauses.catalogText: [每場遊戲1次]將自己檔案區域中具有#きのこ的活動卡1～4張加入手牌。

clauses.catalogText: 之後，每將2張卡加入手牌，就抽1張牌。

clauses.catalogText: [每回合1次]當自己的中央位置有持有#ReGLOSS的Holomen時，對對手的合作Holomen造成50點特殊傷害。

clauses.catalogText: [每場遊戲1次]在對手的回合中，當自己的〈一条莉々華〉被擊倒時可以發動：從自己的牌庫中公開[〈一条莉々華〉與〈限界飯〉]各1張，加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。

clauses.catalogText: [每回合1次]在對手的回合中，當自己的Holomen被擊倒時可以使用：將該Holomen所附著的1張粉絲卡返回手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [每場遊戲1次]選擇自己的一位〈雪花ラミィ〉。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 在此回合中，該選擇的Holomen對對手的一位Holomen造成的特殊傷害+100，且當該Holomen擊倒對手的Holomen時，抽取自己牌庫2張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [每回合1次]在本回合中，當你的Holomen能力一次擲3顆骰子時，將這些骰子的點數全都視為5。

clauses.catalogText: [每場遊戲1次]選擇你的一位擁有#秘密結社holoX的Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 在本回合中，所選的Holomen之Arts可以不消耗應援即可使用。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [每回合1次]在對手的回合中，當自己的〈大空スバル〉要受到對手造成的傷害時可以使用：我方所有〈大空スバル〉本次受到的傷害-30。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [每場比賽1次]當自己的生命值為3或以下時可以使用：本回合內，我方中央位置的〈大空スバル〉的藝能值+100。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [每回合1次] 從自己的牌庫中公開1張〈古代武器〉，並裝備到自己的Holomen身上。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [每場遊戲1次] 從自己的檔案區域將應援，各送1張給每位已裝備〈古代武器〉的Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這位Holomen在牌組中可放入任意張數
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 查看自己牌庫上方3張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從中公開1張擁有[#秘密結社holoX]的Debut成員卡或擁有[#こよラボ]的支援卡，將其加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將剩下的牌以任意順序放回牌庫底。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將自己檔案區域中的1張〈こよりの助手くん〉，裝備到自己其他的〈博衣こより〉上。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從自己的牌庫中公開1張具有 #こよラボ 的支援卡，將其加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當此Holomen裝備〈こよりの助手くん〉時，抽1張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當此ホロメン擊倒對手的ホロメン時，將自己牌庫頂的1張牌放入ホロパワー。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 之後查看自己的ホロパワー，從中公開1張並加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將ホロパワー洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當此ホロメン裝備有持有#こよラボ的支援卡時，從自己的牌庫中公開1張持有#こよラボ的支援卡，將其加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將自己檔案區域中持有#白上's角色的卡1至2張返回手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當自己的舞台上有持有#ゲーマーズ且不是〈白上フブキ〉的Holo成員時，此Arts力量+50。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 自己的舞台上每有1位擁有#Promise的holo成員，這個Arts就+10，最多計算4人。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當這位holo成員被擊倒時，自身生命值-2
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 如果自己的舞台上有5位或以下的Holomen，可以從自己的牌組中公開1張具有▲#Justice▲的Spot Holomen，並將其放到舞台上。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌組洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這張Holomen可以在牌組中放入任意張數。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 在本回合中，使自己舞台上持有#絵的1位成員的藝術值+20。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 查看你牌庫頂的3張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從中公開1張擁有#絵的Holomen，並將其加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將剩下的牌以任意順序放回牌庫底。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [合作位置限定] 當你的中央Holomen擁有#絵時，此Arts力量+80。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這位Holo成員在牌組中可放入任意張數
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 本回合中自己若使用過持有#きのこ的事件時，讓自己持有#ReGLOSS的1位Holo成員回復20HP。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 在對手的回合中，這位Holomen被擊倒時，可以將這位Holomen的一張應援，轉移給自己另一位擁有#ReGLOSS的Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [僅限中心位置] 在對手的主要階段中，這位Holomen的HP不會因對手的能力而減少，也不會發生變動。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以從自己的檔案區域將1張應援卡送給這位Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從自己的牌庫中公開1張帶有#きのこ的事件牌，加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 之後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當自己的推し成員是〈儒烏風亭らでん〉時，可以將這個成員身上的2張應援，分別轉移給自己後方的兩位成員各1張：這個Arts的力量+30。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當自己的推しHolomen是〈白上フブキ〉時，從自己的應援牌庫中公開1張白色應援，送給自己的〈白上フブキ〉。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 之後將應援牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當自己的舞台上有持有#ゲーマーズ且不是〈大神ミオ〉的Holomen時，此アーツ+50。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 將自己應援牌庫頂的1張牌，送給自己的〈クレイジー・オリー〉或〈アーニャ・メルフィッサ〉。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這位Holomen在牌組中可放入任意張數
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以選擇自己舞台上的1～2張加油卡，分配並重新裝備到自己的Holomen上。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 只要對手舞台上有持有[#JP或#ID]的Holomen，這名Holomen的アーツ+30。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 選擇我方1名具有#語学的後場Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從我方應援牌庫中公開1張與所選Holomen相同顏色的應援牌，並將該牌送給該Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將應援牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這張holo成員卡可以在牌組中放入任意張數
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若這回合你曾使用〈限界飯〉，則對對手的合作Holomen造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將自己檔案區域中的1張〈限界飯〉加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的合作Holo成員造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的合作Holomen造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當此招式的對象是對手的合作Holomen時，抽1張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 你可以擲一次骰子：若結果為4以上，且對手沒有合作位置Holomen時，對手必須將自己後排位置的一位Holomen移動到合作位置（此移動不視為合作）。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的中央位置的Holomen造成50點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 之後，如果這回合自己已經使用過〈限界飯〉，則對對手的中央位置Holomen或合作位置Holomen造成30點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對手的中央ホロメン與合作ホロメン各造成10點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這張ホロメン每重疊1張ホロメン，此技能+20。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這張holo成員卡在牌組中可放入任意張數
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將自己檔案區域中的1張工具卡返回手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當我方舞台上有其他持有#ID3期生的Holomen時，從自己的牌庫抽1張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當我方有裝備了持有#カエラ'sアームズ工具的Holomen時，對對手的合作Holomen造成30點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當這位Holomen被擊倒時，我方生命-2
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對方的1位Holomen造成10點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 但即使該Holomen倒下，對手的生命值也不會減少。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這位Holomen可在牌組中放入任意張數
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當自己沒有附有〈雪民〉的〈雪花ラミィ〉時，從自己的牌庫中公開1張〈雪民〉，並將其附加到自己的〈雪花ラミィ〉上。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當有附著自己粉絲的Holomen時，對對手的一位Holomen造成10點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當自己的〈雪民〉附著在〈雪花ラミィ〉身上時，對對手的一位Holomen造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 但即使該角色倒下，對手的生命值也不會減少。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從自己應援牌庫上方將1張卡，送給自己具有〈雪民〉的〈雪花ラミィ〉。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將這位Holomen的一張應援卡送入檔案區域：對對手的1位中央Holomen或後排Holomen造成30點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的後排Holomen 1位造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 之後，若自己的舞台上有與此Holomen顏色不同的Holomen，此技能+50。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這張Holomen可在牌組中放入任意張數
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的一位後排Holomem造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 但即使該角色被擊倒，也不會使對手的生命值減少。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 將應援牌庫最上方1張卡，送至自己持有#EN的Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以公開自己Holopower最上方1張卡：若公開的卡是持有#EN的Holomen，對對手的1位Holomen造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將公開的卡反面朝下放回Holopower的最底部。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當此Holomen被擊倒時，自身生命-2
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這張Holomen可以不受限制地放入任何數量進牌組中
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以擲骰子1次：若為3或以上，使對手的1位後排Holomen進入休息狀態。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對手每有1位處於休息狀態的Holomen，此戰技+10。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以擲一次骰子：若為奇數，將自己檔案區域中持有#秘密結社holoX的1張成員卡返回手牌；若為偶數，將自己檔案區域中持有#秘密結社holoX的1張成員卡放回牌庫頂。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以擲骰子3次：每出現1次奇數，就對對手的中央Holomen造成10點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 將自己1張手牌存檔，可以擲3次骰子：每出現1次奇數，就從自己的牌庫抽1張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 自己的綻放效果「Yes My Dark！」每回合只能使用1次。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對手的中央位置Holomem，本回合中自己每次以能力擲骰子的次數×10，給予特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可將對手檔案區域中的1張應援，送給對手的中場HoloMen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的中場HoloMen與合作HoloMen造成特殊傷害10，數值依對手中場HoloMen所持的每1張應援計算。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當這位HoloMen被擊倒時，自身生命-2
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當自己的SP推し技能「蘇るオリー」Bloom時，將自己1位〈クレイジー・オリー〉的HP全數回復。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 自己的舞台上，每有1位不是此成員且具有#ID2期生的2nd成員，此Arts就+20。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [僅限中心位置・合作位置] 當這位Holomen裝備了〈森カリオペの鎌〉或〈Death-sensei〉時，自己持有#Myth的中心Holomen的Arts效果+30。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 查看自己牌庫頂的2張牌，選擇其中1張放入檔案區，將剩下的牌放回牌庫頂。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當這位Holomen被擊倒時，自身生命-2
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 在對手的回合中，當這位Holomen被擊倒時，從自己的牌庫抽1張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這位Holomen可在牌組中放入任意張數。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將自己的一張紅色應援的ホロメン放到檔案區域：抽兩張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當自己的檔案區域有紅色應援時，此藝術+20。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 數一下自己的手牌，然後可以將全部手牌放進檔案區域：每放入1張卡，就從自己的牌庫抽1張。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 自己的綻放效果「『感情結晶体』」每回合只能使用1次。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對手的檔案區域每有1張應援，這個Arts就+10。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這張Holomen可以在牌組中放入任意張數
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [僅限中心位置・合作位置]此Holomen從對手的1st Holomen受到的傷害-20。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 選擇我方的一位Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 本回合中，該Holomen每有1張應援牌，該Holomen的藝能+10，但最多只計算3張。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從自己的應援牌庫頂抽1張卡，送到這位Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將自己檔案區域中的1張黃應援送給自己的Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 雙方舞台上的每有1張應援，此Arts就+10，但最多只計算8張。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這位Holo成員在牌組中可放入任意張數
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [僅限中心位置]這位Holo成員與自己的合作Holo成員所受到的傷害-10。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將自己檔案區域中的1張〈古代武器〉，裝備到自己的〈アーニャ・メルフィッサ〉上。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 在對手的回合中，當這位Holomen被擊倒時，從包含這位Holomen在內的重疊Holomen中選1張加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [僅限Center位置・合作位置]自己的Center Holomen若為裝備〈古代武器〉的〈アーニャ・メルフィッサ〉，其使用Arts所需的黃色消耗減少1。

clauses.catalogText: 在對手的回合中，當這個Holomen被擊倒時，可以將這個Holomen的一張應援，轉換到自己其他的Holomen上。

clauses.catalogText: 這個Holomen在牌組中可放入任意張數

clauses.catalogText: 從自己的應援牌庫公開1張黃應援，送給這位Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將應援牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 自己的舞台上每有1位持有不同卡名#1期生的Holomen，就可以擲一次骰子：每出現一次4以上的數字，就從自己的應援牌庫頂抽1張牌，送給這位Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 每有1張這位Holomen的應援，此藝術+20。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當自己的舞台上有5位或更少的Holomen時，可以從自己的牌庫中公開1張具有#5期生的Debut Holomen，將其放到舞台上。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這張Holomen可以在牌組中放入任意張數。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從自己的應援牌庫中，公開1張與自己舞台上擁有#5期生的holomen同色的應援，並送給自己擁有#5期生的holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將應援牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 你的檔案區域中每有1張應援牌，這個Arts就+20，但最多只計算5張。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [合作位置限定]自己的Debut成員在中心位置時受到的傷害-20。

clauses.catalogText: 此成員無法進行Bloom

clauses.catalogText: 在對手的回合，當這位Holomen被擊倒時，將你應援牌庫頂的1張牌送給你的Holomen。

clauses.catalogText: 這位Holomen不能進行Bloom

clauses.catalogText: 此卡只有在自己的舞台上有2位以上顏色各為單一且不同顏色的Holomen時才能使用。

clauses.catalogText: 選擇自己舞台上2位顏色各為單一且不同顏色的Holomen。

clauses.catalogText: 從自己的牌庫中，公開各1張與所選Holomen顏色相同且不為Buzz的1st Holomen，加入手牌。

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。

clauses.catalogText: 查看自己牌庫上方4張牌。

clauses.catalogText: 從中公開1張ホロメン，以及1張[工具或吉祥物或粉絲]，將公開的卡加入手牌。

clauses.catalogText: 只能在自己的手牌（不含此卡）不超過6張時才能使用。

clauses.catalogText: 查看自己牌庫頂的4張牌，從中可公開任意數量持有#5期生的ホロメン，將公開的ホロメン加入手牌。

clauses.catalogText: 剩下的卡以任意順序放回牌庫底。

clauses.catalogText: 若你是後攻且為第一回合，從你的牌庫公開1張〈座員〉，加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的合作Holomen造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將自己的1張手牌存入檔案區域：對對手的中央Holomen或合作Holomen造成10點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以擲一次骰子：每出現1點，從自己的牌庫頂依序將1張卡存入檔案區。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 之後，如果自己的檔案區有10張以上，這個Arts額外+10。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這個HoloMen每附有1張〈座員〉，這個Arts額外+10。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [僅限Center位置] 你可以將任意張數的手牌放進檔案區域：每放入1張，從你的檔案區域將1張〈座員〉加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 如果你的推しHolomen是〈尾丸ポルカ〉，你的檔案區域每有10張卡，這個Arts就+30。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [僅限中央位置・合作位置]在對手的回合，當自己的〈さくらみこ〉被擊倒時可以使用：從自己的牌庫中公開1張〈み俺恥〉，並加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將自己的2張手牌存入檔案區域：對對手的中央Holomen或合作Holomen造成50點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若自己的舞台上有〈35P〉，則再抽1張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 如果對手的後排Holo成員HP減少，這個Arts+20。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 如果這位Holo成員同時有紅應援和藍應援，可以從自己的檔案區域將2張應援送給這位Holo成員。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 如果只有其中一種顏色的應援，可以從自己的檔案區域將1張應援送給這位Holo成員。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 將這位Holo成員的所有應援存檔到檔案區域。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [合作位置限定]當你使用了自己的SP應援技能「BAU BAU!」時，直到回合結束為止，這位Holomem的戰術值+70。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若自己的舞台上有2nd Holomem，則再額外令這位Holomem在本回合的戰術值+50。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 如果自己的中衛Holomem是〈フワワ・アビスガード〉，此戰術可以在不消耗1張應援的情況下使用。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 如果這回合自己使用過〈限界飯〉，對對手的Center Holomen與合作Holomen造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若此技能的對象是對手1st以上的合作Holomen，此技能+70。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當此Holomen被擊倒時，自己的生命-2
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若自己的生命為3或以下，則本回合Bloom過的中心Holomen為[〈さくらみこ〉或〈星街すいせい〉]時，可以再使用自己手牌中的Holomen進行一次Bloom。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將這位Holomen的一張應援卡轉移到自己的後排Holomen身上。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 此Holomen同時視為〈さくらみこ〉與〈星街すいせい〉。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的中央Holomen造成10點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 如果自己是後攻且為第一回合，從自己的牌庫中公開1張具有#ゲーマーズ的2nd Holomen，將其加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [限合作位置] 只要自己的中心Holomen具有#ゲーマーズ，對手Holomen的Arts只能指定自己的合作Holomen為對象，但特殊傷害除外。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將此Holomen的一張藍色應援存檔：對對手的中心Holomen與一名後排Holomen各造成10點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 給對手的中心Holomen與一位後排Holomen各造成10點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 自己的Bloom效果「お弁当タイム…？」每回合只能使用一次。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 給對手的一位Holomen造成10點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [僅限中央位置] 自己的應援Holomen〈猫又おかゆ〉與自己舞台上的所有〈猫又おかゆ〉，對對手中央Holomen造成的特殊傷害+20。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的一位Holomen造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 之後，可以將自己檔案區域中的1張應援卡送給擁有#ゲーマーズ的後排Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從自己的牌庫中公開1張〈雪民〉，加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 如果自己的舞台上有持有 #5期生 的2nd成員，對對手的一位成員造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的後排holo成員1人造成10點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的後排Holomen 2人造成10點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的後排Holomen 2人造成10點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 如果對手的後排成員總共已減少80點以上HP，則可以將自己檔案區域中的1張藍色應援送到自己的〈こぼ・かなえる〉。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將這位成員的2張應援送入檔案區域：對對手所有後排成員造成30點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 但即使對手成員因此倒下，也不會使對手的生命減少。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [僅限中央位置] 當自己使用應援技能「モコちゃん！」時，將自己應援牌庫頂的1張牌送給擁有#Advent的自身成員。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若這回合自己的〈モココ・アビスガード〉曾使用過藝術卡，則此藝術卡+40；若這回合曾使用過自己的應援技能「モコちゃん！」，則此藝術卡再額外+30。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當此成員被擊倒時，自身生命-2
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 檢視自己牌庫頂的3張卡，從中公開1張持有#お酒的Holomen，將其加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將剩餘的卡以任意順序放回牌庫底。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若自己的舞台上有3位以上持有#お酒的Holomen，則可以將自己檔案區域中的1張應援卡送給自己持有#お酒的後排Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 如果自己的檔案區域有事件卡，對對手的中心Holo成員造成10點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若自己為後攻且在第一回合，並且自己的推しHolomen是〈癒月ちょこ〉，則抽兩張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這張Arts在本回合中，如果你已經使用過2張以上持有#食べ物的事件卡，則可以不用消耗1張應援就能使用。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [僅限中央位置]當對手的表演步驟結束時，若這位Holomen的HP沒有減少，可以從自己的應援牌庫頂將1張牌送給自己的〈癒月ちょこ〉。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這回合中，你每使用過1張具有#食べ物的事件，此招式就+20，但最多只計算2張。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將自己的2張手牌存檔：將自己檔案區域中1張具有#料理的Holomen加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這個回合中，讓自己舞台上1位擁有#歌的Holomen的Arts+10。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若你是後攻且在第一回合，並且你的主推Holomen是〈ネリッサ・レイヴンクロフト〉，則將自己牌庫頂的1張牌放到HoloPower區。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 如果自己喜推的Holomen是〈ネリッサ・レイヴンクロフト〉，則抽1張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從你的牌庫中公開1張[〈ネリッサ・レイヴンクロフトの杖〉或〈Jailbird〉]，將其加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 你可以將1張手牌存入檔案區域：對對手的中央Holomem或合作Holomem造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當此Holomen擊倒對手的Holomen時，抽取自己牌庫2張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將自己手牌的1～3張卡放進檔案區域：本回合中，每放進檔案區域1張卡，自己舞台上的1位持有#歌的Holomen的Arts+20。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從自己的牌庫中公開2張持有#歌且非Buzz的1st Holomen，將它們加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 對對手的中心Holomen或合作Holomen其中之一，自己舞台上每有1位持有#歌的1st Holomen，造成20點特殊傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以將這位Holomen的一張應援卡放進檔案區域：從自己的牌庫中公開1張與自己舞台上所有Holomen卡名都不同的Debut Holomen，將其加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若你為後攻且是第一回合，從自己的牌庫中公開2張卡名不同的Debut成員卡，加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [合作位置限定][每回合1次] 當除了此Holomen以外的己方Holomen要受到對手傷害時，可以擲1次骰子：若為奇數，該Holomen受到的傷害-40；若為偶數，該Holomen受到的傷害-20。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [限定合作站位] 當自己的持有#3期生的中心Holomen使用Arts時，可以將自己手牌1張存入檔案區域：抽取自己牌組1張。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 自己舞台上每有1位持有不同卡名的#3期生的Holomen，這個Arts的力量+10。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 當這位Holomen使用Arts時，可以將這位Holomen的2張應援送給自己1位後場Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 之後，將自己檔案區域中，與被送應援的Holomen同名的1張1st Holomen加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以擲1次骰子：若點數大於等於自己的生命值，這張Arts獲得+60；若點數小於等於自己的生命值，抽1張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若這位Holomen有攜帶吉祥物，檢視自己牌庫頂的1張牌，將該牌放回牌庫頂或底。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [僅限後排位置]這位Holomen不會受到對手的傷害。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 可以從自己應援牌庫頂抽1張牌，送到這位Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從自己的檔案區域中任意選擇持有#白上's角色的[吉祥物與粉絲]任意張數，分配並裝備到自己的Holomen上。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若你的推しHolomen是〈白上フブキ〉或推しHolomen的顏色為黃，且你的舞台上[道具、吉祥物、粉絲]的合計張數達4張以上，這張Arts +100。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從自己的牌庫中公開1張擁有#ゲーマーズ且不是Buzz的1st Holomen，加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這個回合中，使自己場上1位擁有#ゲーマーズ的Holomen的Arts+30。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: [僅限Center位置]若這位Holomen已附加4張以上的應援，則本回合中，此Holomen與我方的合作Holomen的藝能值+50。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若我的推しHolomen為〈角巻わため〉，則可以將我方應援牌庫頂的1張牌送給我方的〈角巻わため〉。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這位Holomen被擊倒時，我方生命值-2
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 查看你的應援牌庫頂的3張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從中公開1張應援，送到你的〈アユンダ・リス〉。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將剩下的應援以任意順序放回應援牌庫底。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 之後，抽1張牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 如果你的推しHolomen是〈アユンダ・リス〉，則你持有#ID1期生的所有Holomen，每有1張應援，這個Arts就+10。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 但最多只計算10張。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 從自己的牌庫中公開 1～2 張擁有額外效果「這位Holomen在牌庫中可放入任意張數」的Debut Holomen，並將其放到舞台上。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 然後將牌庫洗牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 若放出了 2 張Debut Holomen，則再將自己手牌中的 1 張卡放回牌庫底。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 選擇我方的一位Holomen。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 本回合中，該Holomen進行接棒所需的◇減少2。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 之後，讓選擇的Holomen回復20HP。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這個回合中，我方舞台上的1位Holomem藝術值+10。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 之後，這個回合中，我方舞台上的第2位〈癒月ちょこ〉藝術值+10。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 這張卡不能在不包含這張卡的情況下，手牌超過6張時使用。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 查看自己牌庫上方4張牌，從中公開任意數量的〈白上フブキ〉、〈不知火フレア〉、〈角巻わため〉與〈尾丸ポルカ〉，將公開的Holomen加入手牌。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 剩下的卡以任意順序放回牌庫底。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: LIMITED：每回合只能使用1張。
clauses.textProvenance: catalog text; official Japanese clause and rule interpretation unverified

clauses.catalogText: 必須在不包含這張卡的情況下，自己的手牌必須為6張以下才能使用此卡。
